# Changelog

## 2.4.6-fortran.1

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation of the computational core of
  `pracma` 2.4.6.
- Added modular implementations for array utilities, linear algebra,
  polynomials, special functions, numerical calculus, optimization,
  interpolation, ODE/PDE methods, signal/statistical routines, geometry, and
  combinatorics.
- Added a broad compatibility layer with R/MATLAB-recognizable procedure names.
- Adapted the Goldfarb-Idnani quadratic-programming code to modern Fortran.
- Added four tests, three examples, a demo, documentation, and strict/optimized
  GNU Fortran validation scripts.
